request.style: English, jazz, female warm solo voice, upright bass, brushed drums, saxophone, piano, mood reflective and steady, tempo 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Next to Uzziel the goldsmith stood
A perfumer with hands that could build
In the city of Jerusalem
They worked side by side
Restored the stone as far as the Broad Wall
No one asked for glory or fame
Just the task at hand in the dust
Shoulder to shoulder in the rain

[Chorus]
Hananiah son of Uzziel
Building the wall with steady hand
Next to him a perfumer stood
Adding their part to the plan
The gaps were closed the work went on
Under the eyes of the Lord

[Verse]
Sanballat and Tobiah grew furious
Seeing the gaps being closed
They conspired to fight against Jerusalem
To throw it into confusion and loss
But we prayed to our God day and night
Posting guards against their threat
The laborers said the strength was failing
Too much rubble on the street

[Chorus]
Hananiah son of Uzziel
Building the wall with steady hand
Next to him a perfumer stood
Adding their part to the plan
The gaps were closed the work went on
Under the eyes of the Lord

[Bridge]
Enemies whispered we would be killed
Before they saw the stone set
But the Jews warned us ten times over
We did not let our spirits get wet
The nations around were afraid
When the wall was finally done

[Outro]
Fifty-two days the work was finished
The enemies confidence was gone
The wall stands firm in the history
A testament to the strong
